name: Smoke plume (black)
description: Thick black smoke that starts as a puff and rises into a growing column.

looks.text: A close-up texture swatch of thick black smoke: colour and detail only. It is not an object to place in the shot and says nothing about its shape or direction.

prompt.subject: thick black smoke rising slowly from {where}
prompt.timing: black smoke starts puffing from {where} at {start}, rising by {rising} and billowing wider by {growing}, a broad plume spreading out overhead by {column}
prompt.action: At {start} thick black smoke starts pouring out of {where}. It drifts upward slowly at its own natural pace, billowing and rolling outward, widening as it climbs and thinning into a broad, soft haze that spreads out overhead. It is never a tight, fast column.
prompt.subject_wind: a plume of thick black smoke pouring from {where}
prompt.action_wind: At {start} thick black smoke starts pouring out of {where} at its own slow natural pace and is caught by the wind as soon as it leaves the source, stretching into a long, widening trail that billows and thins as it drifts.
prompt.timing_wind: black smoke starts pouring from {where} at {start}, streaming away on the wind by {rising}, a longer trail by {growing} and a long wind-blown plume by {column}
prompt.timing_preroll: thick black smoke is already pouring from {where} when the shot begins, slowly rising, billowing wider and spreading out overhead throughout
prompt.action_preroll: From the very first frame thick black smoke is already pouring out of {where} and has been for a while: a broad plume drifting slowly upward, billowing outward, widening as it climbs and thinning into a soft haze overhead. It keeps coming at the same slow natural pace throughout.
prompt.timing_preroll_wind: thick black smoke is already pouring from {where} when the shot begins, streaming away on the wind in a long, widening, slowly drifting trail throughout
prompt.action_preroll_wind: From the very first frame thick black smoke is already pouring out of {where} and streaming away on the wind in a long trail that widens, billows and thins as it drifts, at the same slow natural pace throughout.
